periods.label: 破军理事长与旧师决裂
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Mage-Knight League side

status.current: understands Tsukikage's secessionist aim but chooses not to burden her students with it

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Former teacher whom she confronts as an enemy after Akatsuki's attack on Hagun.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Hagun captain; she trusts him and later explains his Edelweiss-derived body signal during the Moroboshi match.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Hagun representative whose delayed match becomes a special four-on-one bout.

periods.summary: Kurono confronts Tsukikage in the banquet smoking room and correctly deduces that his real goal is not educational reform but to force Japan's complete break from the League. Although troubled by facing her old teacher, she answers as Hagun's director and believes her students will ruin his plan by defeating Akatsuki. During Ikki's match she identifies that Ikki's freezing is not fear trauma but his body failing to process the new combat signals learned from Edelweiss.

key_events.summary: Discovers Tsukikage's true aim and refuses to tell students the political burden.
Explains Ikki's abnormal state from the stands.
